description: This file implements a wrapper for the libparodus library, managing connection setup, message reception, and notification sending for a device management system. It includes functions for initializing connections, handling incoming requests, and sending notifications via libparodus, with configuration loaded from device files or defaults.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the initial notification configuration file for libpd.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Signals to stop the parodus receive wait loop.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Main thread function to initialize data model, connect to parodus, register callbacks, and start listening for requests.

methods.name: parodus_receive_wait
methods.description: Loop to receive messages from parodus, process requests, and send responses.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to parodus with retries and exponential backoff.
